title: Electabuzz 125/165 Pokemon 151 Japanese Poke Ball Reverse Holo Pokeball
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card features the beloved characters Electabuzz, Voltorb, and Pinsir, and is part of the exclusive [SV2a] 151 set. The card is made of high-quality card stock and has a stunning Reverse Holo finish, making it a must-have for any serious collector.

This Japanese Poke Ball card is from the Pokémon Trading Card Game, manufactured by The Pokémon Company in 2023. The card is in Stage 1 and has the card number 125/165. It is in Japanese language and features artwork by Shinji Kanda. This card is perfect for fans of the Pokémon franchise, collectors, and anyone who appreciates rare and unique items.
